name: Telegram-iOS
description: https://github.com/TelegramMessenger/Telegram-iOS, a large Bazel-built iOS app with 12 git submodules, built for the iOS Simulator (debug_sim_arm64) with the repository's fake code-signing data. Both sides share one Bazel disk cache ($XCFS_BENCH_CACHE), as the project's README recommends, and it is already filled by a build of the source checkout: this measures what parallel checkouts cost on top of a warm cache. Plain worktrees fetch their submodules the way `git clone --recursive` would; xcfs clones them from the source checkout.
versionCommand: python3 -c "import json; v = json.load(open('versions.json')); print('bazel %s, project wants Xcode %s' % (v['bazel'].split(':')[0], v['xcode']))"

plain.remove: rm -rf {dest} && git worktree prune && git branch -D {branch}

edits.name: edit a function body in a leaf module
edit a function body in a module 48 others import
add a public declaration to that module
